meta.label: Report Dataset Tags
meta.description: Reports how the datasets of this project use tags. Changes nothing.

params.name: show_unused_tags
params.label: Show unused tags
params.description: Tags of the project tag list that no dataset has.

params.name: aggregate_by_tag
params.label: Aggregate by tag
params.description: Checked: one row per tag. Unchecked: one row per tag and dataset.

params.name: recap_to_dataset
params.label: Write to a dataset
params.description: One row per tag and dataset, and per run.

params.name: recap_dataset
params.label: Summary dataset
params.description: A new, empty dataset of this project.

params.name: recap_append
params.label: Append mode
params.description: Unchecked: each run replaces the content.

params.name: on_recap_error
params.label: If the summary is not written
params.description: When the summary dataset cannot be written. The work is done anyway. Use 'Fail the run' in scenarios.
